html:

  • Rekommenderad daglig dos: 1 kapsel
  • Användning: 1 kapsel med 300 ml vatten, helst efter en huvudmåltid

Leverans, retur och garanti

Källtext (live): The Fila Legacy QF is a soft fitness roller skate, ideal for riding with friends or for a lighter workout on your own. The lining incorporates Fila Skates' AirFlow™ technology for maximum comfort and breathability. Anatomical padding is designed to ensure that ankles and feet stay in the correct position throughout the ride. A high boot supports the ankles, while an innovative fastening system, with Velcro straps on the leg arch and a buckle button on the stirrups, ensures secure and personalised laces. The Legacy QF fastening system utilises a locking mechanism where the combined action of the lever, Velcro and ATOP wheel mechanism positioned on the back of the shoe allows for a gradual and even closure across the entire foot. It's a revolutionary, fast and intuitive system that ensures the fit is maintained throughout the ride - unlike traditional laces. To remove the tongue, simply turn the wheel 90 degrees to the left and pull the tongue forward. The aluminium frame is equipped with 4 x 84 mm wheels with ABEC 7 bearings - the best solution for a comfortable ride and easy manoeuvrability in all conditions. Want the perfect balance between practicality and performance? Choose the Fila Legacy QF. The manufacturer is FILA.
